{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", trial.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(trial.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (trial['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = trial['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_count}")

# Check distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_stats = trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print(f"\nMax sample_seq per patient_id:\n{sample_seq_stats}")

# Confirm if there are any non-1 sample_seq values
non_1_max = sample_seq_stats[1:].sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (i.e., re-tested): {non_1_max}")

# Check if assay_batch affects baseline (it shouldn't, per documentation)
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {trial['assay_batch'].unique()}")"}
